missed.title: To those who missed the meeting
missed.hint: Everyone on the people list with an e-mail address who wasn't there. Default.

all.title: To everyone
all.hint: Everyone on the people list with an e-mail address, including those who were there.

selected.title: To selected people
selected.hint: Only the people you tick below.

intro: When a meeting is over, Simon Says e-mails its decisions and tasks. Everyone sees their own tasks first and can opt out in the e-mail or under Account. Test meetings are never sent.
emptyList: The people list is empty. Add people under Board and members.
noneWithEmail: Nobody on the people list has an e-mail address yet. Add addresses under Board and members.
withEmail: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} on the people list {count, plural, one {has} other {have}} an e-mail address.
